actions: Instrumented decoder to debug pixel output issues
Confirmed MSAC correctly initialized (FRAME_HEADER + TILE_GROUP split OBU structure)
Confirmed EOB values are non-zero (coefficients ARE decoded, e.g. EOB=57 for 16x16 block)
Confirmed OBU parsing, partition tree, intra prediction all work (structured output produced)
Confirmed both C89 and dav1d builds compile with 0 errors
Created pixel comparison test (test_c89_ppm.c) measuring PSNR against dav1d reference
Diagnosed remaining root cause: dequant math doesn't match dav1d pipeline
history.outcome: The C89 decoder infrastructure works (MSAC, partition tree, CDF coefficient decode all function). The pixel output diverges from dav1d because of the dequant → transform → reconstruction pipeline. The current code does 'val * deq' without the AV1-spec dequant shift '>> (bit_depth-1)', and the inverse transform doesn't apply size-dependent shifts. Previous attempts to add these shifts over-corrected (all coefficients became 0). The correct dequant formula requires careful integration matching how dav1d's recon_tmpl.c processes coefficients.

blockers: Dequant misses '>> (bit_depth-1)' shift — adding it causes all small coefficients to round to 0, suggesting CDF token values may be incorrect magnitude
Transform misses size-dependent shift — difference between small-tx (4x4) and large-tx (32x32) output scaling
Chroma U/V blocks bypass reconstruct_block entirely — raw coeff tokens added to prediction pixels without dequant or inverse transform
CDF count entries get overwritten by memcpy (ICDF values written to count positions, corrupting adaptation rate)
